inheritance: All original scientific settings and limits apply except the explicit qualification and timing amendments below. Both plans and both runners are fingerprinted before execution.

qualification_amendment.admitted_pattern: Within a run, an otherwise intact trial ends with observed relax45 immediately followed by the next trial_start42. Represent the absent rest46 timestamp as null. No omission before attention/question/run-end is admitted.
qualification_amendment.unchanged: All direction, start, cue, action and relax markers remain observed; all original non-rest interval and window bounds, event order, exact roster, trial counts, class and split preflights remain required.
qualification_amendment.unavailable_check: The missing relax-to-rest interval has no measurable value. Report its unavailable count and exclude it from observed interval statistics; never report it as passed or reconstruct a timestamp.
qualification_amendment.admission_order: All ten participants and all thirty participant-condition pairs must fully qualify before any physiological window extraction or fit.

timing_amendment.encoding: Retain observed values. Encode only unavailable feature values as fixed zero plus availability flag0; observed values get flag1. First trial's preceding-rest flag is0. A missing rest affects its trial's relax duration and the following trial's preceding gap. No label or missing timestamp is inferred.
timing_amendment.comparison: Identical P values and flags enter every learned arm, including all nulls. Train-only standardization and sqrt(P dimension) normalization now use87 rather than85 columns. EEG features, windows and all other estimator settings are unchanged.
timing_amendment.limitation: Missingness patterns absent from a training fold cannot acquire a learned correction. This is an explicit feature-level missing-value encoding amendment, not an equivalent rerun of the original comparison.

execution: One new local attempt outside OneDrive. Preserve original failed attempt and completed structural audit. One prediction freeze, pushed and remotely verified before one score. Any qualification/resource/process failure consumes this attempt; no retry, partial score, tuning or broader missing-marker repair.

resources.wall_includes: qualification, prediction, hash-freeze commit/push and final scoring

unchanged_primary: Inner speech: mean participant NLL(P) minus NLL(joint) >=0.02 nats and the SAME >=9 of10 participants strictly positive versus P, deranged_joint, joint_shuffled, uniform and training_prior. All eight arms and three conditions retained; no secondary rescue.
privacy: No source rows, target identities, signals, per-trial predictions or weights uploaded. Only protocol/code, hashes, sanitized qualification/failure metadata, aggregate metrics and interpretation may be published.
interpretation: Same-day within-person offline four-word prediction beyond the amended measured peripheral/timing alternatives; not cortical origin, cue-independent thoughts, unseen-person model generalization, new-day robustness, arbitrary text, prospective live use or clinical utility. The timing amendment changes the nuisance comparator and must remain explicit.
